vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." Better close to the fire today.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
🍲 A person, maybe 60s eats with A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm — bowls side by side, talk low.
Someone told a joke by the fire. You hear A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek laugh — a real one.
👀 Someone asks the person in their 50s, with a scarred cheek, the midwife a shop-talk question about midwife work. The pause before the answer is long enough to hear.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek).
📋 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. (a natural — good pick) They'll report back by next part.
📋 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek: "I noticed that too. There's more — look closer next time."
💧 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek returns with 10L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
🍂 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm gathers deadfall — 1 stick. The pile grows. (1 sticks now.)
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek telling Devon about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek telling Devon about A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm. The retelling is already better than the event.
💧 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
Devon sets out to find A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
🍲 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek is hunched over their bowl by the fire, eating like it matters.
📋 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. (a natural — good pick) They'll report back by next part.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
You give A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
🪵 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek hauls back 7 wood. The pile grows. (23 logs now.)
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek: "Something's been at the pantry. Not an animal — the jars were moved, not broken."
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." Better close to the fire today.
🚶 Devon is back — found A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek.
Devon sets out to find A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
📋 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. (a natural — good pick) They'll report back by next part.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aroha just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ellie just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ellie just put down Don't-Look... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aishatu just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Ellie, Aishatu, Maria, Aroha and Amina met them at the door — 5 put down. Ellie, Aishatu, Maria, Aroha, Amina are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Yuki taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Yuki has been turning the Ground Elder over — asking after it at fires, handling it on work days — and now knows it deep enough to teach. (Their trade grows: ask them what they know.)
Yuki is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
💡 Ground Elder: the village and a trader know more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
